reason: A source audit found that the custom full-capacity mask uses P + output_cap - 1 KV columns. An O32 profile therefore does not have the O4096 task KV layout.
selection: The same first four requests as the original live profile controls. No task answer or latency selects the requests.
correctness: Compare control and trace outputs, exit depths, and computed argmax IDs. Separately compare the control prefix against the completed primary task output.
limit: A bounded generation prefix with the actual serving allocation shape. It is not complete-task accuracy, an observer-free E2E result, or a whole-generation critical-path decomposition.
